zh.title: 星宇航空9月營收年增69% 客運與貨運同步成長
zh.summary: 星宇航空9月營收年增69%，客運與貨運營收均上升。
body: 星宇航空9月營收為新臺幣49.75億元，年增69%。其中，客運營收37.2億元，年增70%；貨運營收7.06億元，月增5%、年增59%。星宇航空表示，傳統貨運旺季到來，AI伺服器供應鏈拉貨、半導體設備及電子零組件出貨，以及年底購物季備貨需求升溫，航空貨運市場艙位需求持續增溫，公司看好未來貨運市場。
航網方面，星宇航空表示，10月起陸續開闢臺北至峇裏島、臺中至札幌及臺中至名古屋航線。公司也表示，已於9月30日與美國航空展開聯營合作，旅客從臺北飛抵美國後，可透過共掛航班銜接美國航空航網；臺北至鳳凰城及安大略航線在冬季旺季增班至每週5班。

en.title: Starlux September Revenue Rises 69% as Passenger and Cargo Sales Grow
en.summary: Starlux reported 69% September revenue growth, with passenger and cargo revenue both higher.
body: Starlux Airlines reported September revenue of NT$4.975 billion, up 69% year on year. Passenger revenue was NT$3.72 billion, up 70%, while cargo revenue reached NT$706 million, up 5% from August and 59% year on year. The airline said the traditional cargo peak season was arriving, with demand from the AI-server supply chain, shipments of semiconductor equipment and electronic components, and year-end shopping-season stocking needs contributing to stronger demand for air-cargo capacity. Starlux said it was optimistic about the cargo market.

Starlux said it would progressively open routes from Taipei to Bali and from Taichung to Sapporo and Nagoya starting in October. The airline also said it began a joint-operating partnership with American Airlines on September 30. Passengers flying from Taipei to the United States can connect to American Airlines’ network through codeshare flights, according to Starlux. It said Taipei–Phoenix and Taipei–Ontario services would increase to five flights per week during the winter peak season.

zh.title: 漢莎航空波音747-8於洛杉磯機場（LAX）驚險避開尾撞 機師中止降落
zh.summary: 漢莎航空波音747-8在洛杉磯機場驚險避開尾撞；機師中止降落；最終延誤近半小時落地。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，漢莎航空一架波音747-8在洛杉磯機場（LAX）驚險避開尾撞，機師中止降落。
報導指出，該機最終落地時間較表定延誤略低於半小時。
Simple Flying 的標題以「驚險避開尾撞」描述這起事件，並提到機師中止降落。
目前可取得的資料僅止於標題與摘要，未提及事發原因、損傷情況或是否有人受傷。

en.title: Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 avoids tail strike by inches at LAX as pilots abort landing
en.summary: Lufthansa Boeing 747-8; near tail strike at LAX; pilots aborted landing; jet touched down just under half an hour late.
body: A Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 avoided a tail strike by inches at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) as pilots aborted the landing, according to Simple Flying.
Simple Flying reported that the aircraft eventually touched down just under half an hour behind schedule.
The outlet's headline described the occurrence as escaping a tail strike by inches and stated that the pilots aborted the landing.
No cause, damage assessment or injury information was provided in the available material.

zh.title: 希斯洛機場（LHR）稱逾40家航空公司尋求時段，擴建呼聲升高
zh.summary: 希斯洛機場稱逾40家航空公司尋求時段，擴建呼聲升高。
body: 希斯洛機場（LHR）表示，目前有超過40家航空公司尋求取得機場時段，擴建及興建第三條跑道的呼聲也在升高。機場管理層於2026年10月12日表示，時段需求持續超過可用容量；管理層稱，航空公司因此被迫選擇海外競爭樞紐，並使英國失去連結、貿易與成長機會。
希斯洛機場主張，擴大機場可為新航空公司及新航線騰出空間、增加競爭並降低消費者票價。機場發言人另稱，英國各地的航空公司與機場都希望希斯洛加快擴建，以改善連結並促進成長。

en.title: Heathrow Says More Than 40 Airlines Seek Slots as Expansion Calls Intensify
en.summary: Heathrow says over 40 airlines seek slots as calls for airport expansion intensify.
body: London-Heathrow Airport (LHR) says more than 40 airlines are currently seeking access to its slots, as calls for expansion and a third runway intensify. Airport management said on October 12, 2026, that demand for access continues to exceed available capacity. It said this is forcing airlines to choose competing hubs overseas and taking connectivity, trade and growth opportunities away from the UK.

Heathrow argued that a larger airport would create space for new airlines and routes, increase competition and drive down fares for consumers. A Heathrow spokesperson also said airlines and airports across the UK want the airport to expand at pace to improve connectivity and enable growth.

zh.title: 空中巴士U740 Valkyrie無人戰鬥機完成歐洲首次飛行
zh.summary: 空中巴士稱U740 Valkyrie在北歐完成歐洲首次飛行，並達成測試目標
body: 空中巴士表示，U740 Valkyrie無人戰鬥機已在歐洲完成首次飛行。飛行在北歐一處測試設施進行；空中巴士稱，飛機達成此次飛行的各項目標。
空中巴士列出的測試項目包括不依賴跑道的火箭助推起飛、在不同高度進行飛行操作、速度達到Mach 0.8，以及在飛行中調整任務。該公司表示，此次飛行為搭載其MARS任務系統進行更複雜的後續飛行測試鋪路。
空中巴士與Kratos表示，雙方仍以2029年提供可投入作戰的協同作戰飛機為目標，對象包括德國及其他歐洲武裝部隊。

en.title: Airbus U740 Valkyrie completes first European flight
en.summary: Airbus says U740 Valkyrie completed its first European flight at a Northern Europe test facility.
body: Airbus says the U740 Valkyrie uncrewed combat aircraft has completed its first flight in Europe. The flight took place at a test facility in Northern Europe, and Airbus said the aircraft achieved all objectives.

The company said the objectives included a runway-independent, rocket-assisted takeoff, maneuvers at different altitudes, speeds of up to Mach 0.8 and in-flight mission adjustments. Airbus said the flight paves the way for more sophisticated tests with its MARS mission system.
Airbus and Kratos said they remain on track to offer a combat-ready collaborative combat aircraft by 2029 for the German and other European armed forces.

zh.title: Avolon公佈250架空中巴士與波音新機訂單，待股東批准
zh.summary: Avolon公佈250架空中巴士與波音新機訂單，仍待股東批准
body: 飛機租賃公司Avolon表示，已向空中巴士與波音訂購250架新飛機。這批訂單包括140架波音737 MAX，以及110架空中巴士飛機，其中包括75架A320neo系列與35架A330neo系列飛機。
相關訂單仍須Avolon持股70%的股東Bohai Leasing批准。Avolon也取得另外100架空中巴士飛機的選擇權；該選擇權與已提出的250架訂單分開，來源未表示這100架已成為確定訂單。

en.title: Avolon Announces 250 Airbus and Boeing Aircraft Orders, Pending Approval
en.summary: Avolon announces 250 Airbus and Boeing aircraft orders, pending shareholder approval.
body: Aircraft lessor Avolon says it has placed orders for 250 new aircraft from Airbus and Boeing. The announced breakdown is 140 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft and 110 Airbus jets, including 75 A320neo family aircraft and 35 A330neo family aircraft.

The orders remain subject to approval by Bohai Leasing, which holds a 70% shareholding in Avolon, according to the report. Avolon has also secured options for 100 additional Airbus aircraft. The source describes those aircraft as options, separate from the 250 orders, and does not say they have become firm orders.

zh.title: 美國陸軍沙漠演習暴露新興技術限制
zh.summary: 美國陸軍七月沙漠演習測試無人機與指揮系統，並暴露裝備限制。
body: 美國陸軍的 Project Convergence-Capstone 6 演習旨在於接近實際條件下測試新興技術與戰場網路，並測試下一代指揮與控制（NGC2）架構、無人機、自主系統及電子戰裝備。這場為期十天的 Project Convergence 演習於七月在莫哈維沙漠的 Fort Irwin 舉行；報導指出，演習暴露出顯著限制。
報導指出，演習期間伺服器過熱、電池耗盡且無法充電，士兵還把浸過冰水的T恤披在天線上。部分士兵為節省電池並取回無人機，只在有限時段飛行，飛行時間為最大時間的一半；他們也在未使用完整自主功能或AI輔助的情況下操作無人機。

en.title: US Army desert exercise exposes limits in emerging technology
en.summary: The US Army tested drones and command systems as a desert exercise exposed equipment limits.
body: The US Army’s Project Convergence-Capstone 6 exercise was designed to stress-test emerging technologies and battlefield networks under realistic conditions. It tested the Next Generation Command and Control architecture, drones, autonomous systems and electronic warfare equipment. The ten-day Project Convergence exercise took place in July at Fort Irwin in the Mojave Desert; the report said it exposed significant limitations.

Reported problems included overheated servers and batteries that died and could not be recharged. Soldiers also draped ice-water-soaked T-shirts over antennas. Some soldiers flew drones only during limited windows and for half the maximum flight time to conserve batteries and retrieve the drones. They also flew without full autonomy or AI assistance.
